title: Get a permit for an advertising sign in a public place
what: Get the council's permit before putting an advertising sign or bill on a road, footpath, council property or other public place.

laws.title: Town of Port Hedland Local Law (Signs, Hoardings and Bill Posting)

sources.title: Town of Port Hedland Local Law (Signs, Hoardings and Bill Posting)
sources.locator: cl 3.2, as made, Gazette No. 157, 3 Aug 2000
sources.quote: Subject to Clause 3.3 a person shall not erect, attach, affix or maintain any sign or advertising device and the owner or the occupier of premises shall not suffer or permit a sign or advertising device to be erected, attached, affixed or maintained in on or above any land or building (or any part thereof) except pursuant to a licence issued under this Local Law.

sources.title: Town of Port Hedland Local Law (Signs, Hoardings and Bill Posting)
sources.locator: cl 5.22, as made, Gazette No. 157, 3 Aug 2000
sources.quote: A person shall not erect, attach, affix, paint or maintain a sign or advertising device on or as part of a fence on any part of a lot and the owner or occupier shall not permit or suffer a sign or advertising device to be erected, affixed, painted or maintained on any fence or any part of a lot.

confidence_note: Quotes the local law as made, from the WA Government Gazette; WA publishes no consolidated local laws. The clause was found by a pattern search of every Gazette from 1996 to 2026 (E-8), and the law was taken as in force because no later repeal naming it was found.
